title: The Cambridge Companion to Greek Lyric
author: Budelmann, Felix
subject: Greek lyric poetry; classics; classical studies; ancient Greek literature; Sappho; Pindar; Alcaeus; Anacreon; Bacchylides; Simonides; Stesichorus; archaic Greece; literary criticism; Cambridge Companions to Literature; Felix Budelmann
description: Paperback issue in the Cambridge Companions to Literature series, edited by Felix Budelmann; twenty-one essays on Greek lyric from Sappho and Pindar to its later reception, with chronology, glossary and guide to editions. Trade paperback in pictorial wrappers, no dust jacket as issued. A former public library copy: Houston Public Library barcode label to the front wrapper, INFCW label to the rear wrapper, call-number label at the foot of the spine, and DISCARD stamped on the top edge of the text block. Wrappers rubbed at the edges and corners with a small chip at the lower rear corner; spine uncreased and the binding tight. Pages unbroken and clean apart from light pencil markings to some leaves.
